Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1622); a Gergesene (i.e. Girgashite) or one of the aborigines of Palestine:--Gergesene.
BiblicalUsage: Gergesēnós means a Gergesene, one of the people of Gergesa. It stands in Matthew 8:28, where the King James Version reads the country of the Gergesenes — the Greek text behind these studies reads Gadarenes there, so this is the Textus Receptus reading.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the Gergesene reading as the King James translators had it, and I note plainly that the other Greek text reads Gadarenes.
